tasks.completion_summary: Split ScanAndCleanup into scan phase (under lock) and kill phase (outside lock) to reduce mutex hold time from 0.1-5s to just the scan duration

Buffered all Renderer Draw/Clear methods to build ANSI output in bytes.Buffer under lock, then write to terminal after unlock. Three overlay-stack methods (ClearMenu, ResetMenuRegions, ClearCurrentMenu) kept with defer unlock since they write through ScreenManager's own writer.
Replaced tailscaleDNSMu RWMutex with atomic.Pointer[string] + atomic.Int64 timestamp + atomic.Bool busy flag. getTailscaleDNS() is now fully lock-free with async background refresh.

Replaced I/O-under-lock with write-behind channels in both StateManager and SchedulerStateManager. Background goroutines drain write signals with debounce coalescing. Mutex only protects in-memory state. Added Close() for flush-on-shutdown to both managers and wired into daemon Stop().
Moved Scheduler.Start LoadAllTasks() before lock acquisition. Added atomic restartCount/lastRestartTime to processRestartState so Stats() reads atomics instead of acquiring per-process mutex locks.

Added RunAutostartAsync(ctx, projectPath, progress) with AutostartProgress events. RunAutostart delegates with nil progress (backward compat). Replaced layerWg.Wait() with select on layerDone+ctx.Done(). Added WaitReadyCtx to ReadySignaler. Preserved 120s fallback timeout when caller uses context.Background() for backward compat. Progress events emitted at PhaseScriptStarting/DependencyWaitStart/DependencyReady/ScriptStarted/ScriptFailed/LayerComplete.

Added AutostartManager + AutostartHandle in autostart_manager.go with sync.Map-based exactly-once GetOrCreate, RWMutex-protected progress history, Cancel/Progress/Get/Remove APIs, and synthetic PhaseDone event on completion. Moved AutostartPhase/AutostartProgress/phase constants from daemon_autostart.go to the new file (single source of truth), added ProjectPath+Timestamp fields stamped by emitProgress and by the manager drain goroutine. Updated all 6 emitProgress callsites in daemon_autostart.go to pass projectPath. Added PhaseDone constant for overall completion. 8 new tests cover exactly-once, cancel running/completed, progress accumulation, different paths, late-joiner snapshot, path normalization, and Progress query. Full daemon suite passes with race detector in 217s.

Decoupled hubHandleSessionRegister from autostart by wiring the new AutostartManager into Daemon. Registration now calls GetOrCreate with a project-scoped startFn that runs the duplicate scan inside the background autostart run (no more projectMu lock) and tees progress events onto the alert hub as diagnostic log entries. Response schema gained status/autostart_handle/progress/result fields while keeping the legacy autostart map for backward compatibility (populated synchronously when the run finishes before WriteJSON returns). Removed projectLocks sync.Map and getProjectLock from daemon.go; the old per-project mutex tests were replaced with a GetOrCreate-based sharing test. Autostart handles are now removed from the manager in CleanupSessionResources when the last session for a project disconnects (matches the ephemeral registry rule). Added 5 new tests in hub_session_async_test.go covering sub-500ms registration with slow autostart, status=starting/joined/done branches, late-joiner progress snapshot, and no-global-serialization across distinct projects. Also fixed a pre-existing failing E2E assertion (TestE2E_AutostartIdempotent_RestartsAfterAllDisconnect) that contradicted the ephemeral-registry architectural rule. Full daemon suite passes with -race in 217s; all E2E autostart tests pass; gofmt and go vet clean.
